# Brendon Oleghe (Maestro Brendon)

> Brendon Oleghe, known professionally as Maestro Brendon, is a multidisciplinary designer and brand strategist with 7+ years leading design across fintech, Web3, e-commerce, and real estate — 80+ brands built. Work spans brand identity, design systems, motion design, and product/web design, based remotely and working globally.

## Key pages

- [Portfolio homepage](https://maestrobrendon.com/): Featured case studies, skills, and full project archive.
- [About](https://maestrobrendon.com/about): Career history (HEED/The Render Unit, Growmodo, The Matrix HQ, Quintes, LEDGA), education (University of Benin), and side ventures.

## Featured case studies

- [Vaultra Finance — Brand Identity](https://www.behance.net/gallery/244030983/Vaultra-Finance-Brand-Identity): A full brand identity system for a finance platform built to feel secure, modern, and trustworthy.
- [Giftlyft — Brand Identity & Packaging](https://www.behance.net/gallery/244047577/Giftlyft-Brand-Identity-Packaging-Design): Brand identity and packaging design for a gifting platform designed to feel joyful and giftable.
- [LEDGA Finance — Full Branding](https://www.behance.net/gallery/209969707/LEDGA-Full-Branding-and-Identity-Design): Full branding and identity design for a finance platform, built as a cohesive design system.
- [Sheikh Meow — Brand & Social Identity](https://www.behance.net/gallery/234060663/Luxury-Meme-Token-Branding-Social-Media-Identity): Luxury meme token branding and social media identity for a Web3 project.
